Meta_Test_Description: This testcase performs PCIe device enumeration by first writing 0x0 to register at 0xE6004100, then initiating link training (link_training_dm0_x4 or link_training_dm1_x4 depending on DM0_RC/DM1_RC/DM0_EP/DM1_EP compile flags with speed parameter 4). Cache programming is performed by read-modify-write operations on mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF and mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF using set_data() to set bits [14:11] and [6:3] to 0xF, then bits [30:27] and [22:19] to 0xF. After wait_on(20), a combined cache programming pass sets all four bit fields in a single read-modify-write. The test then polls SII0 register at offset 0xC0 until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1, indicating link-up status. Similarly polls SII1 register at offset 0xC0 for the same condition. Under DM0_RC, reads Vendor ID from PCIe slave0 config space at offset 0x0, writes 0x7 to offset 0x4 (command register), then calls mem_base_program_dm0_x4() and mem_base_program_dm1_x4(). Writes 0x1 to SoC registers at 0xE690000C, 0xE6900010, 0xE6900014, 0xE6900018, 0xE6900030, 0xE6900034. Cache disable programming is performed by read-modify-write on both coherency control registers, setting bits [22:19] to 0x0 while keeping other fields, then after wait_on(10), clearing both [30:27] and [22:19] to 0x0. After wait_on(30), BAR sizing is performed on PCIe slave1 by writing 0xFFFFFFFF to offsets 0x10-0x24, reading back, then writing actual BAR values. Same BAR sizing sequence is repeated for PCIe slave0. Finally, polls register at 0xE6004100 until value equals 0x12345678, then calls finish(0).
Test_Description: This test validates PCIe device enumeration functionality. It initializes the PCIe link by performing link training at Gen4 speed, programs the coherency control registers for cache enablement on both PCIe controller instances, and waits for link-up status by polling the SII status registers. Once the link is established, it reads the Vendor ID from the device configuration space via TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG, enables bus master and memory space via TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG, and programs the memory base address windows. The test then configures SoC-level interrupt/control registers, disables cache coherency programming, and performs BAR sizing on both PCIe slave ports by writing all-ones to BAR0_REG through PREF_MEM_LIMIT_PREF_MEM_BASE_REG, reading back the supported size, and programming the actual base addresses. The test concludes by polling a synchronization register until a completion handshake value is received.

2. Conditional link training: call link_training_dm0_x4(4) or link_training_dm1_x4(4) based on compile flags.

4. CACHE PROGRAMMING - PCIE1: same sequence on mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF.
5. wait_on(20).
6. Combined cache programming pass on both PCIE0 and PCIE1.
7. Repeat steps 2-7 (duplicated code block).
8. Poll read_sii0_reg(0xC0) until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1.
9. Poll read_sii1_reg(0xC0) until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1.
10. read_pcie_slv0_reg(0x0) - read Vendor ID.
11. write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4, 0x7) - enable IO/Memory/Bus Master.
12. mem_base_program_dm0_x4() and mem_base_program_dm1_x4().
13. write_reg SoC registers 0xE690000C-0xE6900034 with 0x1.
14. Disable cache programming on both instances.
15. BAR sizing on slave1 and slave0.
16. Poll 0xE6004100 until 0x12345678.
17. finish(0).

Meta_Test_Description: This testcase performs PCIe register write and read-back verification across DBI controller registers, SII registers, and PHY registers. Five DBI controller registers per instance are tested: MSI_CAP_OFF_08H_REG (offset 0x58), MSI_CAP_OFF_10H_REG (offset 0x60), FILTER_MASK_2_OFF (offset 0x720), AXI_MSTR_MSG_ADDR_HIGH_OFF (offset 0x8F4), and UTILITY_OFF (offset 0xC80). Three SII registers per instance are tested: PCIE0_TRANSMIT_HEADER2, PCIE0_TRANSMIT_HEADER3, PHY_CONTROL_23. Three PHY registers per instance are tested at addresses 0xE68860B8/0xE68862B8/0xE68864B8 (PCIE0) and 0xE68A60B8/0xE68A62B8/0xE68A64B8 (PCIE1). The test first reads all registers and compares against default values (chk_rst_val). Then writes test patterns 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555 (and 0x7BAF, 0x1, 0x003B for PHY) and reads back to verify (chk_rd_wr). SII registers are masked with write masks before writing. PHY registers require PHY reset control write (0x01203000) before access. PHY register reads use 16-bit extraction based on address alignment. Test result is determined by err1 and err2 error counters.
Test_Description: This test validates PCIe register write and read-back functionality across three register domains: DBI controller registers (MSI_CAP_OFF_08H_REG, MSI_CAP_OFF_10H_REG, FILTER_MASK_2_OFF, AXI_MSTR_MSG_ADDR_HIGH_OFF, UTILITY_OFF), SII integration registers, and PHY lane registers. It first verifies reset default values for all registers, then performs write-read-back verification using multiple test data patterns to ensure register accessibility and data integrity.
Meta_Test_Steps:
1. chk_rst_val() - Reset value check:
   a. Read rc0_ctl_addr[0..4] and compare with ctl_default[0..4].
   b. Read rc1_ctl_addr[0..4] and compare with ctl_default[0..4].
   c. Read sii0_addr[0..2] and compare with sii_default[0..2].
   d. Read sii1_addr[0..2] and compare with sii_default[0..2].
   e. write_reg(mizar_PCIE0_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL, 0x01203000).
   f. write_reg(mizar_PCIE1_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL, 0x01203000).
   g. Read phy0_addr[0..2] with 16-bit extraction, compare with phy0_default.
   h. Read phy1_addr[0..2] with 16-bit extraction, compare with phy1_default.
2. chk_rd_wr() - Write-read-back check (3 iterations with patterns 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555):
   a. Write chk_val[j] to rc0_ctl_addr[0..4].
   b. Write chk_val[j] to rc1_ctl_addr[0..4].
   c. Write (chk_val[j] & sii0_write_mask[i]) to sii0_addr[0..2].
   d. Write (chk_val[j] & sii1_write_mask[i]) to sii1_addr[0..2].
   e. write_reg(mizar_PCIE0_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL, 0x01203000).
   f. write_reg(mizar_PCIE1_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL, 0x01203000).
   g. Write (chk_val_phy[j] & phy0_write_mask[i]) to phy0_addr[0..2].
   h. Write (chk_val_phy[j] & phy1_write_mask[i]) to phy1_addr[0..2].
   i. Read back and verify all registers.
3. finish(err2 || err1).
Test_Steps:
1. Read all DBI controller registers for both PCIE0 and PCIE1 instances and verify reset default values.
2. Read all SII registers for both instances and verify reset default values.
3. Write PHY reset control to enable PHY register access.
4. Read all PHY registers for both instances with 16-bit extraction and verify reset default values.
5. Write test pattern 0xFFFFFFFF to all DBI controller registers and read back to verify.
6. Write masked test pattern to all SII registers and read back to verify.
7. Write PHY test pattern to all PHY registers and read back with 16-bit extraction to verify.
8. Repeat write-read-back with patterns 0xAAAAAAAA and 0x55555555.
9. Accumulate errors in err1 and err2 counters.
10. End test with finish(err2 || err1) - pass if no errors.
